text:
mira: Quick cross-team check: where are we on Optimize toolkit delivery? Need clarifications on quant recs, batching/caching rollout, and the staging regression alert. Can owners ping status + blockers? (aiming for canary next Wed) 

alex_chen: I own quant recs. Draft ready — will drop doc + perf numbers in a sec. :memo:

devops-bot: [alert] nightly-staging-bench failed 03:12 UTC — latency spike on kv-cache path (p99 420ms -> 1.1s) — ticket #INC-3427

samir_gupta: API change for cache config landed in my branch, PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/452 — needs eng-runtime review for header compatibility. ETA for merge: tomorrow EOD

jen: saw the staging regression. Likely kernel-selection fallback hitting an older path. I'll run a repro with the failing seq-length distribution. @alex_chen can you confirm quant profile used in staging? 

alex_chen: staging used 'q8_optimized_v2' + dynamic_batch=64. Docs + bench: https://docs.redwood/optimize/quant-recs#q8_optimized_v2

michael: numbers pls — what's regression delta vs baseline? Need to decide rollback cutoff. 

alex_chen: baseline p99 = 410ms, staging p99 = 1.05s, token cost up ~12%. CPU side not impacted. Suspect batching config and cache getters.

paul: I can run the smoke harness tomorrow morning across variants. Ping me the exact branch names. 

mira: Thanks. Ownership summary: quant recs — @alex_chen; cache API — @samir_gupta; kernel/runtime verification — @jen; smoke tests — @paul; rollout owner — me (mira). Agree? 

samir_gupta: agree. dependency: we need eng-runtime ACK before merging PR 452. Also need a canary rollback plan. 

mira: Proposed canary plan (short): 
```
- 5% traffic for 2 hours -> monitor p50/p95/p99 + token cost
- 25% for 4 hours if stable
- 100% after 24h stable
- automatic rollback if p99 > baseline * 1.8 or token cost > baseline + 10%
```

jen: fine with thresholds. I'll add a runtime flag to opt out on kernel selection so rollback is fast. 

alex_chen: PR for quant changes: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/457 — need at least 1 more review. @mira can you tag release? :eyes:

mira: tagging release now and adding owners to the release notes. Final ask: reviewers + smoke runs finished by Tue 18:00 PT so we can canary Wed morning. 

paul: I'll queue smoke runs for Tue 07:00 PT and post results here. 

devops-bot: [info] scheduled job: smoke-harness -> Tue 07:00 PT

michael: I'll review PR 457 today. If I see any perf regression pattern I'll call abort. 

mira: Great — leave any follow-ups here. If anything urgent, DM me. :rocket:
